_how_these_were_computed: By hand, independently of plan.py. Level = 800 x 25/100 x 1.10 = 220 per average BFCM-week day. Each phase average (220 x factor) is split so the phase total stays the same: weekday = average x days / (weekdays + 0.9 x weekend days), weekend = weekday x 0.9. Pre-sale and BFCM week have 5 weekdays and 2 weekend days: pre-sale 110 x 7 / 6.8 = 113.24 -> 113, weekend 101.91 -> 102; BFCM 220 x 7 / 6.8 = 226.47 -> 226, weekend 203.82 -> 204. December (4 to 24 Dec) has 15 weekdays and 6 weekend days: 132 x 21 / 20.4 = 135.88 -> 136, weekend 122.29 -> 122. Returns (25 Dec to 15 Jan) has 16 weekdays and 6 weekend days: 88 x 22 / 21.4 = 90.47 -> 90, weekend 81.42 -> 81; 26 Dec x 1.5 = 122.13 -> 122. Hours needed = forecast x 6 / 60. Hours available = shift hours x 0.75. Backlog carried to the next day: 20 Nov clear (11.3 vs 12.0); 21 Nov Sat 10.2 - 3.0 = 7.2; 22 Nov 10.2 + 7.2 - 3.0 = 14.4; 23 Nov 11.3 + 14.4 - 15.0 = 10.7; 24 Nov 11.3 + 10.7 - 15.0 = 7.0; 25 Nov 11.3 + 7.0 - 15.0 = 3.3; 26 Nov 11.3 + 3.3 - 9.0 = 5.6; 27 Nov 22.6 + 5.6 - 15.0 = 13.2; 28 Nov 20.4 + 13.2 - 6.0 = 27.6.
